_comment: Illustrative slice of the shipped text-and-curation layer. Every key is a game identifier, so
this file survives regeneration against a different install - and content it does not mention
still appears, with a fallback title and no prose. That is how a mod-added faction shows up.

groups.title: Projectiles
groups.description: Global projectile behaviour. Mostly unnamed in the game; pages are titled from the class name.

groups.title: Not Recognised
groups.description: Discovered in your install but unknown to this version of ModMaker - usually content from another mod. Editable, but with no descriptions.

SFXProjectile.reason: Abstract base plus 92 subclasses, no TLK names anywhere. In for global projectile changes; pages fall back to the class name.

SFXCustomAction.reason: 607 classes averaging 2.4 properties, none named - animation stubs, not tunable content. Individual exceptions are listed in `curation`.

sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull.reason: the old app had a page for this (powers, matched on display name)

sfxgamempcontent.sfxwave_horde_cerberus.reason: eleven wave instances, not a form page

sfxgamempcontent.sfxdifficultyhandlermp.reason: 2,455 stat values behind four array properties

sfxgame.bioworldinfo.reason: the multiplayer bot settings; the other eleven own properties are conversation, camera, PS3 and single-player leftovers

sfxgame.bioglobalvariabletable.reason: 82 own properties, all of them the ME1/ME2 plot import table - single-player, and nothing a multiplayer mod can use

sfxgamecontentdlc_con_mp5.sfxcustomactio.reason: the SFXCustomAction family is excluded wholesale, but the old app really did have a page for this one

cooldowntime.label: Recharge Time
cooldowntime.text: How long before this power can be used again after it is cast.

impactradius.label: Radius
impactradius.text: How far from the point of impact the effect reaches.

sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull.descriptionAppend: Pull's cooldown starts when the target is released, not when the power is cast.

sfxgame.bioworldinfo/m_nAutoBotMPKit.label: Bot Kit
sfxgame.bioworldinfo/m_nAutoBotMPKit.description: Which multiplayer kit the auto-bot plays as when it fills an empty slot.

sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull.title: Pull
sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull.description: Lifts an unprotected target off the ground and holds it in place.

Banshee.title: Banshee
Banshee.intro: A Reaper unit that casts biotic pulses and is extremely deadly at close range.

groups.title: Armor
groups.description: How much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Barriers
groups.description: How much damage this unit's barriers deflect before health can be damaged.

BansheeAlt.title: Original Banshee
BansheeAlt._note: Ships no legacy page of its own; the Banshee page describes both.

MaxHealth.label: Health
MaxHealth._note: Overridden to "Armor" on armoured units via the category groups.

PowerThreshold_Knockback.label: Knockback Resistance
PowerThreshold_Knockback.description: Incoming force above this threshold knocks the unit down.

waveBaseClass.note: Factions are its descendants, found by walking SuperClass. Never list them.

waveIndex.note: The wave number comes from here, never from the instance name.

matchSettings.usedBy: maplist editor, faction picker, difficulty picker

enemyTypes.note: Second gate on faction reachability, alongside WaveTypes.

challengeTypes.note: ID + 1 = DO_Level<n>. Positional, declared nowhere in the game - a convention, not a lookup.

mpMapNames.note: Recognised only so it is left alone: stale relative to AvailableMaps, and written with indexed assignment.

difficultyData.note: Matched across every section - no handler class is named, which is why it found single-player's fifth level for free. Never count to four.
